blurb: Del Monte Golf Course is the oldest course in continuous operation west of the Mississippi, established in 1897. It features small, sloping, old-school greens and has hosted prestigious amateur tournaments since 1912. The course challenges golfers with its classic design and scenic views of Monterey Bay.
